prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production illustrated background plate for TUMP, a playful Filipino street game, landscape 16:9, ideally 2048 by 1152. Create one original illustration, not a UI mockup. A warm neighborhood lane in the Philippines on a lazy afternoon: a low plaster house, modest corrugated awning, open wooden window, a few potted tropical plants and a broad mango-tree canopy, a short clothesline with only three simple garments. Ground-level slightly elevated view, inviting open street for a game of tumbang preso. A faint hand-drawn chalk circle on the ground near the lower-right third. No people, can, slippers or ball in this plate: those will be separate animated foreground assets. Keep the left 38 percent extremely quiet with broad cream/apricot space for native menu controls; put the house, tree, street perspective and visual interest in the right 62 percent. Spacious, calm, playful composition, no dense scene dressing. Visual language from our supplied original TUMP branding: chunky imperfect dark brick-red contours, flat warm screen-printed shapes, lightly textured paper, softly bent lines, simple swirling tree foliage, playful slightly wonky proportions. Strong authored illustration, not generic vector clip art, not polished corporate SaaS art, not photoreal, not a painterly fantasy landscape, no glossy 3D. Palette: cream #FCD39F and apricot #F8B366 dominant, deep brick #A31A24 outlines, vivid orange #EC6015 and #F35901, golden yellow #F7B722, sparing acid yellow-green #D8D001, foliage olive #6D7738 and deep olive #42421E. Avoid blue, teal, purple, black-heavy shadows. Filipino identity through everyday architecture and neighborhood warmth, no flags, no cultural costume, no sacred writing. Absolutely no words, letters, logos, numbers, UI icons, buttons, panels, frames, watermark, or interface text. Do not recreate or redraw the original TUMP logo. Deliver only this seamless full-bleed background artwork.
prompts.review: Rejected as too sepia and finely detailed beside the chunky original logo.

prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: this newly generated TUMP background plate. Keep its exact composition, empty left 38 percent, Filipino neighborhood lane, house/window/tree/clothesline/chalk circle and all object positions. Change ONLY the rendering language and color treatment: this is currently too sepia, detailed and naturalistic. Redraw with much simpler chunky flat screen-print shapes, visibly hand-drawn uneven deep brick-red #A31A24 outlines, fewer broad shapes per plant, one simple shadow shape per object, no realistic dappled texture or fine leaf veins. Match a playful handmade cartoon game logo, not an anime scenic painting. Distinct balanced colors: light peach cream #FCD39F sky and blank left space, apricot #F8B366 walls, vivid orange #EC6015 roof, clear dark olive #42421E and olive #6D7738 tree masses, small acid lime #D8D001 leaf accents, golden yellow #F7B722 highlights. The color scheme must not collapse into uniform brown/orange/sepia. Retain relaxed nostalgic warmth, spacious open street and minimal quiet left area. No text, logo, buttons, UI, icons, people, can, slippers or ball. No borders, no watermark. Deliver the same full-bleed landscape background plate with the new much bolder simpler graphic style.
prompts.review: Selected for integration: broader brick/olive/cream shapes and quiet left composition. Actual UI capture and motion review pending.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two separate foreground prop sprites in a single 2:1 horizontal atlas for an illustrated Filipino tumbang preso game. Genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha, no opaque paper backdrop. LEFT HALF: one small upright empty unbranded tin can, gently dented, open oval rim seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, chunky handmade deep brick-red outline #A31A24, peach cream metal #FCD39F, simple apricot shadow, two simple horizontal ribs, no label or text. RIGHT HALF: one single rubber flip-flop/slipper viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, toe pointing upper right, lime #D8D001 sole, vivid orange #EC6015 V-shaped strap, chunky uneven brick-red #A31A24 contour, one small flat shadow on the underside. Keep each object centered entirely inside its own half with at least 15 percent transparent margin on every side; no object crossing the center divide. No divider drawn. Style: bold simple playful flat screen-printed cartoon props, charming wonky shapes, matching a quirky chunky hand-drawn game logo, not photoreal, not polished 3D, not corporate clip art, no fine texture. Same stroke weight and perspective for both objects. These are physical objects for a street illustration, not UI controls. Absolutely no words, letters, numbers, logos, impact sparks, motion lines, labels, buttons, borders, watermark, people, extra objects or floor shadow outside the objects. Do not recreate TUMP lettering or the original girlfriend's logo. Output only the isolated can on the left and slipper on the right over actual transparency.
prompts.review: Selected: actual alpha confirmed0..255; separate editable can/slipper sprite rectangles, no lettering. No logo replacement.
